public_release.reason: Current STRATZ permission for API wrapping, caching, redistribution, attribution, and branding has not been obtained in sufficiently explicit terms.

decisions.decision: Local implementation and private testing may continue, but a downloadable general-purpose STRATZ MCP wrapper must not be publicly released until STRATZ confirms this use.
Persistent caching and stale serving may be implemented behind local-development safeguards, but public release remains blocked until retention and cache-use permission is explicit.
Fetched GraphQL schema snapshots must remain local and must not be committed, packaged, or published.
Fetched constants, badges, and other STRATZ-provided static data must remain local and must not be committed, packaged, or published.
Apply the conservative interim attribution 'Data provided by STRATZ' linked to https://stratz.com, while treating exact current placement and referral requirements as unresolved.
Use no STRATZ logos or endorsement claims; identify the project as unofficial. Public naming and trademark usage require explicit confirmation before release.
